t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Gnomes are divided into two categories, earthy colours and not. This affects the score potential of the forest, but the score potential can change throughout the game.

vb_textbox.text: Gnomes are divided into two categories: Green, Yellow, Orange and Brown (Red Basket), and Pink, Purple, Red, and Blue (Gold Basket). Each category has a different chance of a higher mushroom yield. This chance changes throughout the game. Try both categories and test which one gives a consistently higher yield, then continue to choose the higher category. Perform the test again every so often or whenever you feel the yield has decreased.
